resourceContract.hotPath: Feature visibility checks can run during UI routing and must remain simple set membership checks.
resourceContract.idle: Idle state is a small UserDefaults string array and no live observer is required.
resourceContract.memory: The enabled capability id set is bounded by the app capability catalog size and copied into memory only for feature checks.
resourceContract.scale: Expected tens of capability ids; 1,000 ids remains a small set lookup, and 100,000 ids is outside product scope for this local preference.
resourceContract.startup: Feature flag opt-in ids are read only when feature visibility is evaluated; no background service starts from this key.
resourceContract.storage: Writes a sorted capability id array to UserDefaults with host-local retention until the user clears or changes the opt-in.
resourceContract.streaming: No stream is attached to this preference key; changes are explicit settings writes.
resourceContract.validation: node scripts/surface_resource_contract_guard.mjs and Clawix feature flag tests

completingSurface.human: Feature-gated Clawix settings and runtime selectors that expose opted-in capabilities only after the user enables them.
completingSurface.programmatic: FeatureFlags.setCapabilityOptIn(_:capabilityID:) stores sorted capability ids in UserDefaults under FeatureFlags.enabledCapabilityIDs.

surfaceNarrative.concept: Debug builds persist explicit opt-ins for beta or experimental capability ids so feature maturity gates remain user-controlled and stable surfaces stay visible by default.
surfaceNarrative.nonInference: This key does not authorize production developer surfaces, bypass release-build feature gates, or make any incomplete capability stable.
